newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up 0.07 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 497.23 points from 496.88 on Monday.
Total volume was 1.04 million dinars against 429,422 dinars over the previous session.
Most of the trade was on BDET bank with 14,276 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 17.42 dinars.
Tunisian company Le Moteur was up 0.7 dinar to 33.7 dinars. Chemical firm Industries Chimiques du Fluor rose 0.2 dinar to 56.2.

Retail stores Monoprix fell 0.72 dinar to 36.78 dinars. UBCI bank was down 0.68 dinar to 48.02. Compagnie Internationale de Leasing eased 0.31 dinar to 17.42 dinars. Banque de Tunisie, which was holding its annual general meeting on Tuesday, edged down 0.3 dinar to 78 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie declined 0.22 dinar to 35.78 dinars. Investors had already anticipated last week a BIAT post-tax dividend of ten percent for the 1996 results. ($1=1.08 dinar)
